```{r}
# set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/provi/Provines GitHub/Provines-DS-6400")

# load original dataset
riboflavin <- readRDS("riboflavin.rds")

# reconstruct predictor matrix
X <- matrix(as.numeric(riboflavin$x), nrow = nrow(riboflavin$x), dimnames = dimnames(riboflavin$x))

# combine response and predictors
riboflavin_df <- data.frame(Sample = rownames(X), y = riboflavin$y, as.data.frame(X, check.names = FALSE))

# export to CSV
write.csv(riboflavin_df, "riboflavin.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# inspect dimensions
dim(riboflavin_df)
```
